ranks.name: Deckhand
ranks.unlock: One starter contract on each board.

ranks.name: Trader
ranks.unlock: Full board: 3 contracts, rush jobs open.
ranks.heading: Known on the quay
ranks.promo: The harbour knows your name. You are a Trader now.
ranks.rival: So the harbour talks about you now. Enjoy it while it lasts.

ranks.name: Merchant
ranks.unlock: Second cargo deck at the Shipwright. Tier 2 contracts.
ranks.heading: The guilds take note
ranks.promo: Your word is good in every port. You are a Merchant now.

strings.failed: The buyer found another captain. {renown} Renown, deposit lost.

delivery.title: Salt for pickling
delivery.giver: Salt's salt. Get it there dry.
delivery.risk: Rain at sea can spoil an open hold.

delivery.title: Dates for Debal
delivery.giver: My cousin waits. Don't make him wait long.
delivery.risk: Pirates watch the open water past the coast.

delivery.title: Copper for smiths
delivery.giver: Heavy load. Honest pay. That's all.
delivery.risk: Customs in Muscat search some ships.

delivery.title: A jeweller's pearl
delivery.giver: A diver bled for this one. Mind it.
delivery.risk: One pearl draws pirates like gulls to bait.

rush.title: Salt for the feast
rush.giver: Feast's soon. Sail now, not tomorrow.
rush.risk: A storm could eat the days you have.

rush.title: Copper, fast
rush.giver: Forge is cold. They pay double, quick.
rush.risk: Head winds can cost a week.

rush.title: Wedding dates
rush.giver: No dates, no wedding. Hurry, friend.
rush.risk: One bad storm and the wedding is over.

rush.title: A pearl, in haste
rush.giver: He sails home soon with or without it. Catch him.
rush.risk: Pirates and storms both slow a rush run.

delivery.title: Pepper for kitchens
delivery.giver: Finest pepper, finest price, go go!
delivery.risk: Pirates like a hold that smells of spice.

delivery.title: Cotton for weavers
delivery.giver: Bolts of cloud, my friend. Muscat loves it.
delivery.risk: Customs in Muscat search some ships.

delivery.title: Indigo for a dyer
delivery.giver: Blue like the sea, worth more than the sea!
delivery.risk: Rain can stain a careless cargo.

delivery.title: Tea for the court
delivery.giver: Court tea! Court pay! You'll thank me.
delivery.risk: Open water past the coast draws pirates.

rush.title: Pepper, sell high
rush.giver: Quick, quick! The price won't wait.
rush.risk: A storm could cost you the margin.

rush.title: Cotton, rush order
rush.giver: Muscat wants it yesterday. Can you?
rush.risk: Head winds can cost a week.

rush.title: Tea for a caravan
rush.giver: Caravan leaves at dawn. Be there!
rush.risk: Storms and searches both eat time.

rush.title: Festival indigo
rush.risk: One storm and the festival is gone.

delivery.title: Temple incense
delivery.giver: The temples expect this. Do not fail them.
delivery.risk: Pirates know what incense is worth.

delivery.title: Coffee for traders
delivery.giver: A gift of good faith. Treat it so.
delivery.risk: The coastal run is calm, but storms come.

delivery.title: A pearl, discreetly
delivery.giver: A single pearl, captain. Speak of it to no one.
delivery.risk: Even one pearl draws pirates on open water.

delivery.title: Dates for the poor
delivery.giver: The Sultan's charity. Carry it well.
delivery.risk: Rain at sea can spoil an open hold.

rush.title: Funeral incense
rush.giver: There is no second day for this. Go.
rush.risk: A storm would make you late for the dead.

rush.title: Coffee for a guest
rush.giver: The guest arrives soon. So must you.
rush.risk: Head winds can cost a week.

rush.title: A betrothal pearl
rush.giver: The bride's family awaits this pearl. Do not keep them.
rush.risk: Pirates and storms both slow a rush run.

rush.title: Dates to break fast
rush.giver: When the fast ends, they eat. Be there.
rush.risk: One storm could cost the whole run.

endgameContracts.note: Game Designer final endgame ruling 2026-10-17: starts on reaching Merchant (300 Renown); one big contract at a time in its own slot (not counted in the 2-contract limit); fixed sequence of 3, each to a different port; 2 moons each; pay = expected sale value at the destination + bonusCoins, own cap; Renown = renownMult x a normal delivery's Renown; no fame; the 3rd completion finishes the run. Amounts are being checked by Game Researcher against the price table.
endgameContracts.failNote: OPEN (needs Game Designer ruling): on a miss the same contract is offered again; failRenown = 3x a normal delivery's fail
endgameContracts.label: Grand contract

sequence.title: Dates for the Debal feast
sequence.giver: Twenty sacks, and the whole quarter eats. Buy them in Gwadar or Muscat.
sequence.risk: A full hold rides low. Pirates notice.

sequence.title: Copper for the Muscat foundry
sequence.giver: The Sultan's foundry wants Gwadar copper, twenty ingots, no less.
sequence.risk: Customs in Muscat search some ships.

sequence.title: Indigo for the Gwadar dyers
sequence.giver: Bring Debal's blue home. Twenty bales and your name is made.
sequence.risk: Rain can stain a careless cargo.

strings.runCompleteBody:
Three grand contracts, three ports, every one delivered on time. Your name is made from Gwadar to Muscat.

The run is finished. Free trading goes on.
strings.slot: Its own slot: does not count toward your 2 contracts.
